keyEvents.text: Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Bournemouth 0. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Javi Rueda.
Bafodé Diakité (Bournemouth) is shown the red card.
Álvaro Rodríguez (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Celta Vigo 1, Bournemouth 0.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Tyler Adams replaces Justin Kluivert.
Second Half begins Celta Vigo 1, Bournemouth 0.
Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Bournemouth 1. Álvaro Rodríguez (Bournemouth) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Amine Adli with a cross following a set piece situation.
Javi Rodríguez (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Javi Rueda (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ryan Christie replaces Alex Scott.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Álvaro Núñez replaces Couhaib Driouech.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Hugo Álvarez replaces Javi Rueda.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Adrien Truffert replaces Julio Soler.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Rayan replaces Amine Adli.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Marcus Tavernier replaces David Brooks.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Ferran Jutglà replaces Pablo Durán.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Williot Swedberg replaces Javi Rodríguez.
Goal! Celta Vigo 1, Bournemouth 2. Rayan (Bournemouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Marcus Tavernier following a fast break.
Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Ángel Arcos replaces Hugo Burcio.
